history.subtitle: Our journey from 2018 to 2026 — growing with your trust.

item0.title: The Beginning
item0.desc: LA Group Andika Trans was established in Yogyakarta with an initial fleet of 2 vehicles, providing daily rentals and local shuttle services.

item1.title: Fleet & Service Expansion
item1.desc: Our fleet grew to more than 10 vehicles. We started serving domestic tourists and introduced daily tour package services.

item2.title: Expansion & Digitalization
item2.desc: Launched an online reservation system and expanded our service reach throughout Java & Bali. Partnered with various digital travel platforms.

item3.title: Tour Package Launch
item3.desc: Introduced private and group tour packages to Bali, Lombok, and prime destinations across the archipelago using tourist buses.

item4.title: Innovation & Continuous Growth
item4.desc: Providing an integrated digital platform, strengthening premium services, and continuing to grow as a trusted travel partner for both domestic and international tourists.

policies.requirementsSubtitle: Required documents and rules before handover
policies.requirementsContent:
• Must bring original ID card (KTP) and other guarantees (minimum 3 guarantees).
• Students must bring their student card (KTM).
• Vehicle usage is 12 Hours / Full Day (maximum drop off at 22:00 to Hotel/Airport/Station/Terminal).
• Prices are subject to change at any time.
policies.generalSubtitle: Basic rules for using L.A Rent & Tour vehicles
policies.generalContent:
• L.A Rent & Tour hands over/leases the vehicle to the lessee who has accepted, leased, and used the vehicle in ready-to-use condition.
• The lessee has no right to transfer the vehicle belonging to L.A Rent & Tour to another person.
• The vehicle is strictly prohibited from being used for illegal activities, racing, or off-roading.
• The vehicle must not be used as collateral (pledged/pawned) for any purpose and to any party.
• Extension of vehicle rental must be with permission from L.A Rent & Tour, notified at least 6 hours before the rental period expires.
policies.paymentContent:
• Rental fees must be paid in advance.
• Full payment is made on the day of the rental.
• In case of rental cancellation, the lessee will be charged a daily rental fee.
• L.A Rent & Tour reserves the right to charge a late return fee of 10% per hour.
policies.liabilityContent:
• The vehicle is not insured. All damages, losses, legal violations, natural disasters, riots, and accidents during the rental period are the sole responsibility of the lessee.
• In the event of damage or loss of the car due to the lessee's fault, L.A Rent & Tour has the right to demand compensation and all costs incurred will be the lessee's responsibility.
• If the car is damaged and needs to go to the repair shop, the lessee is responsible for the repair costs plus compensation of 50% of the rental price calculated during the repair period.
• If airport or station parking cards are lost, the lessee is responsible for the loss.
• During the rental period, the vehicle is under the full responsibility of the lessee.
policies.handoverSubtitle: Joint inspection of the vehicle condition
policies.handoverContent: • For the body check, the lessee and rental provider agree to perform a thorough check and double-check together before and after the vehicle is taken.
policies.legalSubtitle: Legal basis and conflict resolution process
policies.legalContent:
• L.A Rent & Tour reserves the right to report to the authorities under charges of embezzlement at least 1 × 24 hours after the rental period ends if there is no communication.
• These terms constitute an official agreement between L.A Rent & Tour and the lessee and are governed by the laws of the Republic of Indonesia.
• If during the rental period the lessee is subject to legal sanctions, falls ill, or passes away, the responsibility is transferred to the lessee's heirs.
• The agreement is made and signed in good faith and healthy condition without coercion from any party. Matters not yet covered will be regulated later.
• Anything arising from this agreement will be resolved through deliberation. If no consensus is reached, both parties agree to resolve the issue at the Yogyakarta District Court.

pricelist.title: How to Use Vehicles Pricelist
pricelist.step1Desc: On the Pricelist page, each vehicle has different rental duration options. Some vehicles can be rented for 12 hours (Half Day) or 24 hours (Full Day). This information can be seen in the vehicle description.
pricelist.step2Desc: If you have difficulty finding a suitable vehicle, use the filter feature to speed up your search. For example:
pricelist.step3Desc: To view specifications, amenities, and complete vehicle information, simply press the "Book Now" button on the vehicle you want to choose.

tours.title: How to Book Tour Packages
tours.step1Desc: On the Tour Packages page, you can choose from various exotic tour packages. Select a tour package to view detail itineraries, destinations, inclusions, and exclusions.
tours.step2Desc: Inside the tour detail page, select the vehicle option and set the number of participants. The total price will automatically update based on your configuration.
tours.step3Desc: Complete the booking form with your contact details and dates. Click "Order Package Now" to proceed with ordering via WhatsApp.
